meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型模拟细胞代谢,预测基因敲除、通量与产量变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做系统生物学或代谢工程,想用计算模型预测菌株表现
copy.tagline_en: Simulate cell metabolism with constraint models to predict knockouts, fluxes, and yields
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study systems biology or metabolic engineering and want model-based predictions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能加载或构建基因组尺度代谢模型(SBML、JSON、YAML),跑 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样、产率包络等分析,并给出目标值和各反应通量。
howto.when: 当你要求加载或导出 SBML 等代谢模型,或运行 FBA、基因敲除筛选等分析时触发。

say.text: 对 textbook 模型做单基因敲除,列出生长接近零的必需基因
say.note: 输出每个基因敲除后的生长值

say.text: 算一下 textbook 模型在 50% 最大生长下的最小培养基
say.note: 返回需要的最少培养基组分

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can load or build genome-scale metabolic models (SBML, JSON, YAML) and run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling and production envelopes, returning objective values and per-reaction fluxes.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to load or export SBML metabolic models, or to run FBA, gene knockout screens and similar COBRA analyses.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model and run FBA; tell me the growth rate.
say_en.note: Returns objective value and per-reaction fluxes.

say_en.text: Run single gene deletions on textbook and list essential genes.
Compute a minimal medium for textbook at 50% max growth.
